rationale: Micah's work on visual intuition for machine learning systems and interactive data visualization directly complements Artem's deep ML infrastructure expertise in efficient inference and transformer architectures. Both are focused on ml-infra and llm-tooling domains, and at a hackathon, Micah's conviction that interactive visualization is the key interface between AI and human decision-making pairs naturally with Artem's hands-on builder approach to ML systems—creating an opportunity to prototype tooling that bridges model internals and usability.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Artem Yatsenko — you're both focused on ml-infra and llm-tooling, and your combination of visual ML interfaces and efficient inference expertise could make for a powerful hackathon collaboration.
